instruction: Using Apple Notes, go ahead and create a new note with the title "Packing List", placing it inside the "Travel" folder.
reference_command:
cat > /tmp/memo_auto_add.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
file="$1"

cat > "$file" <<'TXT'
Packing List

TXT
EOF

chmod +x /tmp/memo_auto_add.sh
EDITOR=/tmp/memo_auto_add.sh memo notes --folder "Travel" --add
